say:1:1541109001:1.text: Master <style="stress"><player_name></style>, why do you keep staring at my tail?
say:1:1541109001:1.male: Master <style="stress"><player_name></style>, why do you keep staring at my tail?
say:1:1541109001:1.female: Master <style="stress"><player_name></style>, why do you keep staring at my tail?

choice_prompt:2:1541109001.text: Master <style="stress"><player_name></style>, why do you keep staring at my tail?
choice_prompt:2:1541109001.source_cn: <style=stress><player_name></style>大人，为什么一直盯着加拉的尾巴看？
choice_prompt:2:1541109001.male: Master <style="stress"><player_name></style>, why do you keep staring at my tail?
choice_prompt:2:1541109001.female: Master <style="stress"><player_name></style>, why do you keep staring at my tail?

say:3:1541109002:1.text: Why ask? Of course you can.
say:3:1541109002:1.source_cn: 您为什么发问？当然可以。
say:3:1541109002:1.male: Why ask? Of course you can.
say:3:1541109002:1.female: Why ask? Of course you can.

say:4:1541109004:1.text: Modra says that when I was born, my tail was small and ordinary.
say:4:1541109004:1.source_cn: 蒙多说，加拉出生的时候，尾巴还很小，没有什么特殊。
say:4:1541109004:1.male: Modra says that when I was born, my tail was small and ordinary.
say:4:1541109004:1.female: Modra says that when I was born, my tail was small and ordinary.

say:5:1541109005:1.text: But as I grew, it got bigger.
say:5:1541109005:1.source_cn: 但是，随着加拉成长，尾巴越来越大。
say:5:1541109005:1.male: But as I grew, it got bigger.
say:5:1541109005:1.female: But as I grew, it got bigger.

say:9:1541109009:1.text: When it's shedding season, I have to brush it all the time.
say:9:1541109009:1.source_cn: 换毛的季节，需要经常梳理。
say:9:1541109009:1.male: When it's shedding season, I have to brush it all the time.
say:9:1541109009:1.female: When it's shedding season, I have to brush it all the time.

say:10:1541109010:1.text: The god like his offerings clean and pure, so Modra spends hours helping me comb it.
say:10:1541109010:1.source_cn: 神喜欢干净纯洁的祭品。蒙多会花很长时间，帮加拉梳理尾巴...
say:10:1541109010:1.male: The god like his offerings clean and pure, so Modra spends hours helping me comb it.
say:10:1541109010:1.female: The goddess like her offerings clean and pure, so Modra spends hours helping me comb it.

say:11:1541109011:1.text: I can't let it drag on the ground, or touch wet grass, or get soaked with dew.
say:11:1541109011:1.source_cn: 走路的时候，尾巴不能碰到地面，要避开草丛，不能被露水打...
say:11:1541109011:1.male: I can't let it drag on the ground, or touch wet grass, or get soaked with dew.
say:11:1541109011:1.female: I can't let it drag on the ground, or touch wet grass, or get soaked with dew.

say:12:1541109012:1.text: And... when I sleep, I can't lie flat.
say:12:1541109012:1.source_cn: 还有……睡觉的时候，不能平躺。
say:12:1541109012:1.male: And... when I sleep, I can't lie flat.
say:12:1541109012:1.female: And... when I sleep, I can't lie flat.

choice_prompt:13:1541109012.text: And... when I sleep, I can't lie flat.
choice_prompt:13:1541109012.source_cn: 还有……睡觉的时候，不能平躺。
choice_prompt:13:1541109012.male: And... when I sleep, I can't lie flat.
choice_prompt:13:1541109012.female: And... when I sleep, I can't lie flat.

say:15:1541109014:1.text: At night, I curl up with it. It's warm.
say:15:1541109014:1.source_cn: 睡觉的时候，尾巴可以抱着。很温暖。
say:15:1541109014:1.male: At night, I curl up with it. It's warm.
say:15:1541109014:1.female: At night, I curl up with it. It's warm.

say:16:1541109015:1.text: And warm things... well, they make people happy.
say:16:1541109015:1.male: And warm things... well, they make people happy.
say:16:1541109015:1.female: And warm things... well, they make people happy.

choice:13:0:1.text: Sounds like a lot to deal with.
choice:13:0:1.male: Sounds like a lot to deal with.
choice:13:0:1.female: Sounds like a lot to deal with.

choice:7:0:1.source_cn: 它给你带来了很多麻烦？

say:18:1541109008:1.text: It's not that... just that it can be a bit of a hassle.
say:18:1541109008:1.male: It's not that... just that it can be a bit of a hassle.
say:18:1541109008:1.female: It's not that... just that it can be a bit of a hassle.
